name: testing-rosetta-stone
description: Compare the same testing concepts across open-source frameworks

scripts.test:unit:js: npm run test -w @trs/example-assert-vitest && npm run test -w @trs/example-assert-jest && npm run test -w @trs/example-assert-node && npm run test -w @trs/example-parametrize-vitest && npm run test -w @trs/example-parametrize-jest && npm run test -w @trs/example-mock-vitest && npm run test -w @trs/example-mock-jest
scripts.test:unit:py: python3 -m pytest samples/python-calc examples/unit/assert-equality/pytest examples/unit/parametrize/pytest examples/unit/mock-dependency/pytest -q
scripts.test:integration:js: npm run test -w @trs/example-http-get-supertest && npm run test -w @trs/example-http-get-playwright && npm run test -w @trs/example-error-contract-supertest && npm run test -w @trs/example-error-contract-playwright
scripts.test:ux: npm run test -w @trs/example-ux-navigate-playwright && npm run test -w @trs/example-ux-navigate-cypress && npm run test -w @trs/example-ux-form-playwright && npm run test -w @trs/example-ux-form-cypress
scripts.test: npm run test:unit:js && npm run test:unit:py && npm run test:integration:js && npm run test:integration:py && npm run test:ux
